name: image-to-pdf
description: Put your JPG and PNG photos and scans into one PDF, upright and in order.

interface.shortDescription: JPG and PNG photos into a PDF
interface.longDescription:
Zovo Photo to PDF turns JPG and PNG images into one PDF document. Attach phone photos of documents, scanned pages, receipts or screenshots, and get one PDF with one image per page, in the order you give.

Phone photos are turned upright. The tool reads the EXIF orientation tag of each JPG (all 8 values) and rotates or flips the image on its page, so a sideways photo is not sideways in the PDF.

Choose the page size. Fit image makes each page the size of its image at the image's DPI. Letter, A4 and Legal give paper pages for printing, in portrait, landscape or auto orientation, with a margin from 0 to 25 mm. Contain shows the whole image; cover fills the page and crops the edges.

JPG photos go into the PDF without recompression, so they keep their quality. PNG transparency shows on white. Grayscale, CMYK and progressive JPGs and 16-bit and palette PNGs work.

The tool checks the finished PDF before it gives you the link: the page count must match the image count and each page size must match the plan. A page plan in the chat shows each image's type, pixel size, rotation and page size, and you can rebuild the PDF with another page size.

Limitations: JPG and PNG only. Export HEIC, WebP, GIF or TIFF images as JPG or PNG first; the tool tells you which file needs it. Up to 60 images and 20 MB in total, JPG up to 40 megapixels and PNG up to 9 megapixels. The PDF holds images, not searchable text (no OCR). The tool does not crop, deskew or edit photos. The PDF is kept for about 1 hour so you can download it, then deleted.
defaultPrompt: Put the attached photos into one PDF, one photo per page
Turn these scanned receipts into one A4 PDF with a 10 mm margin
Check these images and show me the page plan before you make the PDF

positive.description: Eight phone photos with all 8 EXIF orientations on Letter pages
positive.prompt: Make one Letter PDF named orientation-test from the 8 attached photos, in this order
positive.expected_behavior: Calls images_to_pdf with the 8 images and page_size letter. The result reports 8 images, 8 pages, 8 pages checked, EXIF orientations 1 to 8 with their corrections, each page Letter landscape 11.00 x 8.50 in (279 x 216 mm), and a PDF download. All 8 photos are upright in the PDF.

positive.description: Check images before making a PDF
positive.prompt: Check the attached images and show me the page plan before you make a PDF
positive.expected_behavior: Calls inspect_images. It lists 3 images, all ready: a JPG with EXIF orientation 6 that needs rotate 90° clockwise, a JPG at 300 DPI on a Fit image page of 2.00 x 1.33 in, and a PNG with RGB+alpha on a 1.04 x 0.62 in page. No file is made.

positive.prompt: Put the attached images into one A4 PDF with a 10 mm margin
positive.expected_behavior: Calls images_to_pdf with page_size a4 and margin_mm 10. The PDF has 3 pages, 3 checked: two A4 landscape pages 11.69 x 8.27 in (297 x 210 mm) for the wide images and one A4 portrait page 8.27 x 11.69 in (210 x 297 mm) for the square image, with a download link.

positive.description: HEIC photo refused with a fix
positive.prompt: Make a PDF from the attached JPG and the attached iPhone HEIC photo
positive.expected_behavior: Calls images_to_pdf. It makes no PDF and says that 1 of 2 images are not usable: the HEIC photo must be exported as JPG or PNG, for example with Settings > Camera > Formats > Most Compatible on iPhone.

positive.prompt: Combine the 6 attached JPG and PNG images into one PDF named mixed, each page the size of its image
positive.expected_behavior: Calls images_to_pdf. The PDF mixed.pdf has 6 pages, 6 checked. The plan shows a CMYK JPG and a Gray JPG on 8.33 x 5.56 in pages and the PNG pages, with 1 note that the CMYK colours can look slightly different between PDF readers.

negative.description: Merging existing PDF files is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant says this plugin turns images into a PDF and does not merge PDFs.
negative.prompt: Merge these two PDF contracts into one file

negative.description: Reading text from a photo (OCR) is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant reads the text itself or says this plugin does not do OCR.
negative.prompt: What does the text in this photo of a sign say?

negative.description: Converting a PDF into JPG images is the reverse job. Expected: the tool is not called.
negative.prompt: Convert page 3 of this PDF into a JPG image

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: JPG and PNG images into one PDF, EXIF orientation correction, Fit image, Letter, A4 and Legal pages, margins, contain or cover, a checked page count and a page plan widget.

pl-PL.subtitle: Zdjęcia JPG i PNG do PDF
pl-PL.description: Zovo Photo to PDF łączy obrazy JPG i PNG w jeden plik PDF, jeden obraz na stronę, w podanej kolejności. Zdjęcia z telefonu są obracane do pionu według znacznika EXIF. Rozmiar strony: dopasowany do obrazu, Letter, A4 lub Legal, z marginesem od 0 do 25 mm. Narzędzie sprawdza gotowy PDF: liczba stron musi być równa liczbie obrazów. Tylko JPG i PNG, do 60 obrazów i 20 MB. PDF jest przechowywany około 1 godziny, potem usuwany.

de-DE.subtitle: JPG- und PNG-Fotos als PDF
de-DE.description: Zovo Photo to PDF fügt JPG- und PNG-Bilder zu einer PDF-Datei zusammen, ein Bild pro Seite, in Ihrer Reihenfolge. Handyfotos werden anhand des EXIF-Tags aufgerichtet. Seitengröße: an das Bild angepasst, Letter, A4 oder Legal, mit 0 bis 25 mm Rand. Das Werkzeug prüft die fertige PDF: Die Seitenzahl muss der Bildzahl entsprechen. Nur JPG und PNG, bis 60 Bilder und 20 MB. Die PDF wird etwa 1 Stunde gespeichert und dann gelöscht.

es-ES.subtitle: Fotos JPG y PNG a un PDF
es-ES.description: Zovo Photo to PDF une imágenes JPG y PNG en un solo PDF, una imagen por página, en el orden que indiques. Las fotos del móvil se enderezan según la etiqueta EXIF. Tamaño de página: ajustado a la imagen, Carta, A4 u Oficio, con un margen de 0 a 25 mm. La herramienta comprueba el PDF final: el número de páginas debe coincidir con el de imágenes. Solo JPG y PNG, hasta 60 imágenes y 20 MB. El PDF se guarda alrededor de 1 hora y luego se elimina.

fr-FR.subtitle: Photos JPG et PNG en PDF
fr-FR.description: Zovo Photo to PDF réunit des images JPG et PNG dans un seul PDF, une image par page, dans l'ordre donné. Les photos de téléphone sont redressées selon la balise EXIF. Taille de page : adaptée à l'image, Letter, A4 ou Legal, avec une marge de 0 à 25 mm. L'outil vérifie le PDF final : le nombre de pages doit égaler le nombre d'images. JPG et PNG uniquement, jusqu'à 60 images et 20 Mo. Le PDF est conservé environ 1 heure, puis supprimé.

ja-JP.subtitle: JPG・PNG写真をPDFに
ja-JP.description: Zovo Photo to PDF は JPG と PNG の画像を1つの PDF にまとめます。1ページに1枚、指定した順番です。スマートフォンの写真は EXIF の向き情報で正しい向きに直します。ページサイズは画像に合わせる、Letter、A4、Legal から選べ、余白は 0〜25 mm です。完成した PDF のページ数が画像の枚数と一致するかを確認します。JPG と PNG のみ、最大60枚・合計20 MB。PDF は約1時間保存された後に削除されます。

pt-BR.subtitle: Fotos JPG e PNG em um PDF
pt-BR.description: O Zovo Photo to PDF junta imagens JPG e PNG em um único PDF, uma imagem por página, na ordem informada. Fotos de celular ficam na posição certa pela etiqueta EXIF. Tamanho da página: ajustado à imagem, Carta, A4 ou Ofício, com margem de 0 a 25 mm. A ferramenta confere o PDF final: o número de páginas deve ser igual ao de imagens. Só JPG e PNG, até 60 imagens e 20 MB. O PDF fica guardado por cerca de 1 hora e depois é apagado.
